title: The first launch of a freshly linked large executable is slow and holds the process-wide INHERITANCE_LOCK, so every other launch in the process waits behind it
outcome: It is known whether, on Windows, the CreateProcess of a freshly linked executable (antivirus first scan) runs under host_command's INHERITANCE_LOCK long enough to stall other launches in the same process past their wall-clock budgets, and what to change if it does: for tests, avoiding first launches of fresh binaries under the lock; for the product, whether any host launch can meet a first-scanned binary.
acceptance: The first launch of a freshly linked large executable is slow and holds the process-wide INHERITANCE_LOCK, so every other launch in the process waits behind it is done
